# Mixergy for Home Assistant

> Home Assistant custom integration for Mixergy smart hot water tanks. Cloud-polling integration for the official Mixergy API (www.mixergy.io): live charge and temperatures, hot water boost, a native water-heater entity, PV diverter monitoring and controls, holiday scheduling, Energy Dashboard support, and per-tank services. Installed through HACS as a custom repository. Requires Home Assistant 2025.8 or newer. MIT licensed.

Key facts:
- Domain: `mixergy`; one config entry per tank; multiple tanks supported
- Two experience modes: Simple (monitoring + boost slider) and Advanced (full control surface incl. water heater, heat-source select, PV controls, holiday pickers)
- Services: `mixergy.set_holiday_dates`, `mixergy.clear_holiday_dates`, `mixergy.boost_charge` — all accept entity/device/area targets
- Energy: cumulative electric and PV kWh sensors compatible with the HA Energy Dashboard, plus an optional tariff-based cost sensor
- Alerts: configurable low / no hot water binary sensors and device triggers
- Cloud polling every 30–300 s (default 30); credentials stay in the HA config entry; TLS-verified requests only
